name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Textarea, drawn like Input: 2px ink line that thickens on hover, 3px with ink / paper / ink on focus, italic placeholder, dashed line and tone frame when disabled, accent line and a "!" mark on aria-invalid.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/textarea". It wraps your own components/ui/textarea, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Input's ink line, for longer text.
